commandLine:
"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$reviewDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'docs/reviews/evidence/PREP-003-R2'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $reviewDir -Force | Out-Null
& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/Integration/Collect-Perf.ps1 -DurationSec 2 -Label reviewer-normal -TargetPid $PID -OutDir $reviewDir *> (Join-Path $reviewDir 'normal-run.txt')
\"COLLECTOR_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE\"
Get-Content (Join-Path $reviewDir 'normal-run.txt')
$testProcess = Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-Command','Start-Sleep -Seconds 3' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/Integration/Collect-Perf.ps1 -DurationSec 6 -Label reviewer-early-exit -TargetPid $testProcess.Id -OutDir $reviewDir *> (Join-Path $reviewDir 'early-exit-run.txt')
\"EARLY_EXIT_COLLECTOR_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE\"
Get-Content (Join-Path $reviewDir 'early-exit-run.txt')
Get-ChildItem $reviewDir -Filter '*.csv' | ForEach-Object { $_.Name; Get-Content $_.FullName }
Get-Content docs/TASKS.md | Select-Object -Skip 312 -First 12"
label: reviewer-normal
